subject: Segmented invoice adjustment for storage add-on after autoscaling
messages:
From: Leah Summers <leah.summers@heliocloud.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@heliocloud.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Segmented invoice for storage add-on after autoscaling

Hi Aisha,

Quick one — we noticed on today’s bill that an extra storage add-on charge was applied partway through our current billing cycle after a short autoscaling event on Nov 24. That charge appears to be for the partial period between Nov 24–30 and was billed to our EU entity (HelioCloud B.V.).

Will Redwood be able to:
- split that storage add-on charge so the partial-period consumption is invoiced pro rata (we prefer a separate line on the invoice), and
- confirm the VAT treatment — we operate under an EU VAT ID and need the invoice to show the correct VAT (or zero-rate if applicable).

Attached the usage export filtered to the storage add-on (usage-report-nov24.csv). We’d like to get a corrected invoice or credit note so our AP can process payment this week.

Can you confirm next steps and ETA?

Thanks,
Leah

Leah Summers
Sr. Procurement Lead | HelioCloud B.V.
leah.summers@heliocloud.com
+44 20 7946 0XXX

Attachment: usage-report-nov24.csv (CSV, 18KB)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Summers <leah.summers@heliocloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Segmented invoice for storage add-on after autoscaling

Hi Leah — thanks for the clear note and for the usage file. I’ve looped in Finance (Marissa) and Billing Ops (Rishi) to validate the numbers and propose the cleanest path to get you a corrected invoice.

Immediate plan:
1) Rishi will reconcile the storage add-on allocation against the autoscaling event and produce a two-line adjustment (credit for the over-applied whole-month line and a pro-rated charge for Nov 24–30).
2) Marissa will advise on VAT handling once you confirm the billing entity and provide the EU VAT ID. If we can validate the VAT ID, we typically zero-rate intra-EU B2B; otherwise local VAT will apply.
3) We’ll issue a credit note + corrected invoice (PDF) and post both to the HubSpot billing record and the Drive folder.

ETA: draft to you within 48 hours if no further questions. If you need it faster, let me know and we’ll prioritize.

Could you confirm the exact billing entity and share the VAT ID here? Also confirm if AP requires a separate invoice for the credit (we can issue both a credit note and a replacing invoice).

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Summers <leah.summers@heliocloud.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Segmented invoice for storage add-on after autoscaling

Hi all — I pulled the reconciliation this morning and attaching a draft invoice and the reconciliation CSV. Summary:

- Observed spike: storage consumed triggering add-on between 2026-11-24 03:00 UTC and 2026-11-24 06:00 UTC.
- Original billed amount (full add-on month): EUR 3,120.00
- Pro-rated period (Nov 24–30 inclusive): chargeable portion = 21.7% (7/31 days) -> EUR 676.10
- Suggested adjustment: credit full billed add-on EUR 3,120.00, then apply prorated charge of EUR 676.10. Net credit = EUR 2,443.90

VAT handling: You indicated HelioCloud B.V. — please confirm the VAT ID. If you provide a valid EU VAT ID that matches the billing entity, we can zero-rate the replacement invoice (intra-EU B2B), and the credit will reflect the same treatment. If no VAT ID is provided, we must apply local VAT at invoicing time.

I’ve attached: invoice-draft-20261127.pdf (PDF, draft replacing invoice + credit note reference) and the calc sheet (usage-recon-nov24.csv). Once Leah confirms VAT ID, we’ll:
- finalize the credit note and replaced invoice,
- update HubSpot record HS-394512, and
- send both to HelioCloud and post in Drive (link below).

If that plan looks good, I’ll finalize and have Billing Ops send the corrected documents by EOD Monday.

Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: invoice-draft-20261127.pdf, usage-recon-nov24.csv
